params.body:
Five wording points Shane raised as a French user, plus three follow-ups from the same screens.

**1. "Op stock zetten" → "Op stock"** (`ownstock.put_on_stock`): nl "Op stock", fr "En stock", en "In stock", de "Auf Lager". Step button and row menu in the own-stock list.

**2. Transport request modal** (R S4-10.16, new)
- The vehicle class reads in the UI language: `VehicleClass` / `VehicleClassItem` get a `name` accessor (`name_<locale>`, Dutch when the column is empty); `TransportService::getVehicleClass` uses it for the modal, and keeps `item_name_nl` for what the request stores (`vab_transport_name` stays Dutch for the office mails). The detail modal reads the class through `Transport::ClassName`.
- Form in the house vocabulary: facts in `ui-transport-facts` with a 220px label column (VIN and the report title on one line), a missing dimension as a compact `ui-affix` field with its unit, addresses / switches / note in a one-column `ui-form-grid`, both switches as identical `ui-toggle-row`s with the report explanation as a quiet line under its title (new `transport.electronic_car_short`), the footer buttons in `ui-form-actions`. Fields, names and validation unchanged; the delivery placeholder "Kies een leveradres" is now a key.
- Cancel while waiting for payment (R S4-10.12 extended, ernst nu): a dealer who aborted at Mollie had only "Betaal". `Transport::isCancellable()` adds `waiting_payment`; the controller first asks Mollie (paid meanwhile → stays paid, 422), then withdraws the open checkout via `MollieService::cancel` where `Outbound::impact('mollie')` allows it, otherwise it expires on its own. Pinned in `TransportChainTest`.

**3. Showroom slides** (R S2-7.15, new): the link on the settings tab carries `?lang=<UI locale>`; the public screen has no session and `setLang` already reads `?lang`. `DealerController::showroomLang()` hands `$lang` to the slide (fuel via `name_<lang>`, default nl), the affiche download renders in the same language, "auto lease" / Openen / Kopieer / Gekopieerd are keys, de gets `waranty_till` and `or`.

**4. "geen limiet" and "tot"**: `Enumeration::getRadiusOptions` (settings Website tab, vehicle form) and the Stocklist filter chips (`StocklistBrowser::rangeLabel` "vanaf/tot", plus Bouwjaar, Merk, Carrosserie, BTW-voertuig ja/nee, Dealergroep, Verkoper, Land, Postcode, Zonder premium-aanbod) are keyed in nl/fr/en/de.

**5. RealGarant contract language** (R S4-6.21, new; R P3-8.2 updated; finding `2026-09-15-polis-taal-altijd-nederlands.md`, beslist Shane): the `X-User-Data` header was a fixed `nl_NL`. Now `order->lang` wins, then the UI locale (`SetLangMiddleware`: the dealer's switch, else his settings), then nl. Codes in `RealGarantService::LOCALES` (nl_NL, fr_BE, en_GB, de_DE); fr_BE/en_GB/de_DE are not tried against the live API, see the finding.

**Coordinator additions**
- The "Taal" select of a new offer, order and loan agreement is preselected in the language the user works in (`Enumeration::getDefaultDocumentLanguage`, R S4-2.6 updated); an existing document keeps its own language.
- `Order.add_extra` next to "+" in the extras box: the key was missing in fr/en/de (Laravel showed the key, `ucfirst` capitalised it). Added, and `DocumentLanguageDefaultTest` guards that no `trans('X.…')` call capitalises a translation file name.

**Tests**: `ContractLanguageTest` (3), `DocumentLanguageDefaultTest` (3), two new cases in `TransportChainTest`; `RealGarantWireShapeTest` message updated. Filter run (Transport|Showroom|Contract|RealGarant|Order|Stocklist|Settings|CompiledViews|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity|AlpineExpression|StylesheetSyntax|DocumentLanguage|FrenchTranslations|HandlerWiring): 344 tests, 2378 assertions, green after the fix. SmokeTest `ownvehicle.edit` fails locally only because `public/js` is not built in the worktree.

Screenshots (fr, before/after, 1440 and 390): `.playwright-mcp/wording-round/transport-{before,after}-{1440,390}.png`.
params.title: Wording: 'Op stock', transport modal in the UI language, showroom slides translated, contracts in the requested language
